sheets.prompt: Environment design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the port of a city of heaped rounded adobe houses on islands floating in the black of space, joined by pale arched bridges, cables hanging into the void, a great pale planet over the roofs. A round pier island at the city's edge where a long boxy starship lands on a ring of painted marks, iron docking cradles hung off the pier's rim on cables with little lamp-boats moored in them, a harbour lamp-mast, a harbourmaster with a chalk board, oil casks and lamp crates, small craft circling slowly between the islands. Three panels: the pier from above three-quarter with the bridge running off to the city, one docking cradle close with a person for scale, three small craft side by side. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream, salmon and coral walls, dark teal iron, warm lamp light, black starry space, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
